scope: Minimal persisted-state surface: save/restore through the declared stateSchema, plus actionable validation errors
checks: t3-extension build . exits 0 and emits a checkable .t3-extension package
built client registers in the real host, renders, and session.save persists {count, label}
closing and restoring the saved record reopens the view with the saved count
restore of a wrong field type, a missing required field, and a non-object state are each unavailable with a reason naming surface, expectation, received value and fix
a stateVersion mismatch is rejected as incompatible before validateRestore runs
session.save with an out-of-schema value throws the same actionable error
a surface that declares neither stateSchema nor validateRestore rejects non-null state with a message telling the author what to declare
notProven: installation into a real T3 environment or any host UI rendering
migration of state saved by a previous extension version
state larger than a counter record, or host payload-bound edge cases
